The '''NovaQuad-D Drive System''' was a model of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The system was installed on the [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class medium freighter]], and was the precursor to the system used in the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="SS" />
